basic_info.description: Perched atop San Francisco's iconic Telegraph Hill at the corner of Green and Montgomery Streets, 301 Green Street presents a rare opportunity for investors or owner-users to claim a stake in one of the City's most historic and sought-after neighborhoods. This classic 4-unit building consists of two 1-bedroom units and two 2-bedroom units, each filled with period charm, high ceilings, and abundant natural light. One 2-bedroom unit will be delivered vacant. The property also includes an in-law unit, a workshop/storage area, and a one-car garage, all of which will be delivered vacant. North Beach, Embarcadero, and the Financial District are only steps from the front door. 301 Green Street offers investors and owner-users the rare opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco history.
